name: todo-api
description: The backend REST API for personal task management: create, list, update (text and completed state), and delete tasks, each scoped strictly to the signed-in caller. Sits behind the gateway, which injects the caller identity from the validated Thunder token; the API never trusts a client-supplied user id. Does not send notifications or reminders, and does not support sharing tasks between users.

dependencies.name: todo-db
dependencies.description: Stores each user's tasks (text, completed state, timestamps), scoped by owning user id.

dependencies.name: todo-auth
dependencies.description: Validates the caller's Thunder-issued token and resolves the signed-in user id used to scope every task operation.
